title: The Way of Wisdom and Folly

questions.question: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn her seven what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:1 (ESV): "she has hewn her seven pillars."

questions.question: She has slaughtered her beasts; she has mixed her wine; she has also set her what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:2 (ESV): "she has also set her table."

questions.question: Whoever is simple, let him turn in what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:4 (ESV): "Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!"

questions.question: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:10 (ESV): "and the knowledge of the Holy One is insight."

questions.question: For by me your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:11 (ESV): "and years will be added to your life."

questions.question: She has sent out her young women to call from the highest places in the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:3 (ESV): "from the highest places in the town,"

questions.question: Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:5 (ESV): "and drink of the wine I have mixed."

questions.question: Do not reprove a scoffer, or he will do what to you?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:8 (ESV): "Do not reprove a scoffer, or he will hate you;"

questions.question: Reprove a wise man, and he will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:8 (ESV): "reprove a wise man, and he will love you."

questions.question: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:9 (ESV): "Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be still wiser;"

questions.question: The woman Folly is loud; she is seductive and knows what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:13 (ESV): "she is seductive and knows nothing."

questions.question: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest places of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:14 (ESV): "on a seat at the highest places of the town,"

questions.question: Calling to those who pass by, who are going straight on their what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:15 (ESV): "who are going straight on their way,"

questions.question: Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:17 (ESV): "and bread eaten in secret is pleasant."

questions.question: But he does not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:18 (ESV): "that her guests are in the depths of Sheol."

key_verse_text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One is insight.
